title: 台湾の頼総統、エスワティニに「国王専用機」で到着　「中国の妨害」で4月に一時取りやめ
extracted_text: 【台北＝西見由章】台湾の頼清徳総統は2日、中国による妨害を理由に先月22日からの訪問を一時取りやめたアフリカのエスワティニ（旧スワジランド）に到着した。総統府が発表した。台湾紙の自由時報（電子版）によると、頼氏はエスワティニ国王の専用機に搭乗して同国を訪問したという。 総統府は当初予定されていた出発直前の21日、頼氏の搭乗機の飛行ルート上にあったアフリカ大陸沖のマダガスカルなど島嶼（とうしょ）国3カ国が上空の管理空域「飛行情報区（FIR）」の飛行許可を突然取り消したため、安全面を考慮して訪問を延期すると発表。「中国当局が経済的威圧などの強い圧力を（3カ国に）加えた」と非難していた。 頼氏はフェイスブックに搭乗機のタラップ上で手を振る自身の写真を投稿し「世界の善良な勢力と助け合い、利益を与え合うのは奪うことのできない台湾人の権利だ」と訴えた。 自由時報によると、エスワティニのドラドラ副首相が4月末、国王のムスワティ3世の専用機で台湾を訪問。頼氏はこの専用機に搭乗してエスワティニに向かった。
translated_text: [Taipei = Nishimi Yua] Taiwan President Lai Qingde arrived in the African kingdom of Eswatini (formerly Swaziland) on June 2nd, after temporarily postponing his visit that had been scheduled since May 22nd due to interference by China. This was announced by the Presidential Office. According to Taiwan's Liberty Times (online edition), Lai visited the country aboard the Eswatini King's private plane. The Presidential Office had originally announced on May 21st, just before the scheduled departure, that the visit would be postponed due to safety concerns after three island nations including Madagascar, which lay along the flight path of Lai's aircraft, suddenly revoked flight permits for the Flight Information Region (FIR) - the airspace they manage. They accused "the Chinese authorities of applying strong pressure, including economic coercion, on the three nations." Lai posted a photo of himself waving from the boarding stairs on Facebook, writing, "It is the unalienable right of Taiwanese people to help and share benefits with the good forces of the world." According to the Liberty Times, Eswatini's Deputy Prime Minister Dlamini visited Taiwan at the end of April aboard King Mswati III's private plane. Lai then traveled to Eswatini aboard this same private plane.
title_en: Taiwan President Lai Arrives in Eswatini Using King's Private Plane, Trip Previously Postponed in April Due to Chinese Interference
